28069.subject: Technical Drawing
28069.question_text: Construct a perpendicular bisector to a given line segment AB of length 60 mm. Label all construction lines and points clearly.
28069.explanation:
1. Draw line segment AB = 60 mm.
2. With A as center and radius greater than half of AB, draw arcs above and below AB.
3. With B as center and same radius, draw arcs intersecting the previous arcs at points C and D.
4. Join C and D to form the perpendicular bisector of AB.
5. Label all points (A, B, C, D) and construction lines clearly.

28070.subject: Technical Drawing
28070.question_text: Construct a regular hexagon with side length 30 mm using the circumscribed circle method. Show all construction lines.
28070.explanation:
1. Draw a circle with radius 30 mm.
2. Mark a point A on the circumference.
3. Using the same radius, step off points B, C, D, E, and F around the circumference.
4. Join the points A, B, C, D, E, and F to form the hexagon.
5. Label all points and construction lines clearly.

28071.subject: Technical Drawing
28071.question_text: Construct a tangent to a given circle of radius 25 mm from an external point P, 50 mm from the center O of the circle. Show all construction lines.
28071.explanation:
1. Draw the given circle with center O and radius 25 mm.
2. Mark point P 50 mm from O.
3. Join O and P.
4. Construct the perpendicular bisector of OP to find midpoint M.
5. With M as center and radius OM, draw a semicircle intersecting the given circle at T.
6. Join P and T to form the tangent.
7. Label all points and construction lines clearly.

28072.subject: Technical Drawing
28072.question_text: Draw the front, top, and right-side views of the given object in first-angle orthographic projection. The object is a rectangular block 40 mm × 30 mm × 20 mm with a 15 mm diameter hole drilled through the center of the largest face.
28072.explanation:
1. Draw the front view: 40 mm (width) × 20 mm (height) rectangle with a 15 mm diameter circle centered.
2. Draw the top view: 40 mm (width) × 30 mm (depth) rectangle with a 15 mm diameter circle centered.
3. Draw the right-side view: 30 mm (depth) × 20 mm (height) rectangle with a 15 mm diameter circle centered.
4. Ensure all hidden lines (dashed) are shown for the hole.
5. Label all views and dimensions clearly.

28073.subject: Technical Drawing
28073.question_text:
Given the front and top views of an object in first-angle projection, draw the missing right-side view.
Front view: A rectangle 50 mm × 30 mm with a semicircle of radius 15 mm on top.
Top view: A rectangle 50 mm × 20 mm.
28073.explanation:
1. Analyze the front and top views to determine the object's shape.
2. The front view shows a semicircle on top, indicating a half-cylinder.
3. The top view shows a rectangle, confirming the base is rectangular.
4. Draw the right-side view: 20 mm (depth) × 30 mm (height) rectangle with a semicircle of radius 15 mm on top.
5. Label all views and dimensions clearly.

28074.subject: Technical Drawing
28074.question_text: Draw a full sectional front view of the given object, which is a hollow cylinder with an external diameter of 50 mm, internal diameter of 30 mm, and height of 40 mm. The cutting plane passes through the center.
28074.explanation:
1. Draw the front view as a rectangle 50 mm (width) × 40 mm (height).
2. Draw the internal diameter as a dashed line (30 mm) centered within the external diameter.
3. Apply hatching to the sectioned area (between the external and internal diameters).
4. Label all dimensions and the cutting plane clearly.

28075.subject: Technical Drawing
28075.question_text: Draw an isometric view of a rectangular block with dimensions 60 mm × 40 mm × 30 mm. Include all construction lines.
28075.explanation:
1. Draw the isometric axes at 30° to the horizontal.
2. Mark the length (60 mm), width (40 mm), and height (30 mm) along the axes.
3. Complete the top face by drawing lines parallel to the axes.
4. Project vertical lines downward to complete the block.
5. Label all dimensions and construction lines clearly.

28076.subject: Technical Drawing
28076.question_text: Develop the lateral surface of a right circular cone with a base diameter of 50 mm and slant height of 60 mm. Show all construction lines.
28076.explanation:
1. Calculate the circumference of the base: $C = \pi d = \pi imes 50$ mm.
2. Draw a sector of a circle with radius 60 mm (slant height) and arc length equal to the circumference.
3. The sector angle $ heta$ is calculated as $ heta = rac{C}{2 \pi r} imes 360° = rac{50 imes 360°}{2 imes 60} = 150°$.
4. Draw the sector with angle 150° and radius 60 mm.
5. Label all dimensions and construction lines clearly.

28077.subject: Technical Drawing
28077.question_text: Draw the line of intersection between a vertical cylinder of diameter 40 mm and a horizontal cylinder of diameter 30 mm, where the axes intersect at right angles. Use first-angle projection.
28077.explanation:
1. Draw the front and top views of both cylinders.
2. In the top view, the vertical cylinder appears as a circle (40 mm diameter), and the horizontal cylinder appears as a rectangle (30 mm width).
3. Project points of intersection from the top view to the front view.
4. Draw the curve of intersection in the front view by joining the projected points.
5. Label all views and construction lines clearly.

28078.subject: Technical Drawing
28078.question_text:
Dimension the following orthographic views of a simple bracket:
Front view: A rectangle 50 mm × 30 mm with a 10 mm diameter hole centered 15 mm from the top.
Top view: A rectangle 50 mm × 20 mm with a semicircular end of radius 10 mm on the right side.
28078.explanation:
1. In the front view, dimension the overall height (30 mm) and width (50 mm).
2. Dimension the hole: diameter (10 mm) and its vertical position (15 mm from the top).
3. In the top view, dimension the overall width (50 mm) and depth (20 mm).
4. Dimension the semicircular end: radius (10 mm) and its position.
5. Ensure all dimensions are placed outside the views and aligned with dimension lines.
